title: Per-question answer timing floor is 500ms, not the /apply 2s posture AC6 prescribed (helpers reused as-is)
detail: AC6 prescribed the /apply helper as-is (<2s or >7d); the answer POST/PUT endpoints instead enforce a 500ms floor, so scripted submissions need only pause 500ms to pass the AD-15 timing gate. Documented in spec decision 12 ('Flagged for Perkins').
recommended_fix: Restore the 2s floor on the no-JS POST path (each 303-to-GET re-stamps _form_loaded_at, so a legit fast tap cannot trip it) and keep the lower floor only for the single-page JS PUT.
